reference: User-provided Cathopedia home screenshot dated 14 October 2026
commonPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE full-height mobile app concept image, ONE phone only, not a collage. The attached screenshot is the edit/reference target for the Cathopedia app. Create a high-fidelity alternative for ONLY the scrolling content beneath the Today's Readings card. Preserve the existing Cathopedia header, logo, St Peter's dome artwork, Ordinary Time chip, Today's Readings card, scripture citations, Bible/candle artwork, existing five gold-and-green navigation medallions and their asymmetric floating bar, phone frame and camera. Keep those fixed regions as faithful to the screenshot as possible. Keep the same screen proportions; DO NOT shrink or redesign the fixed reading card to make room for the lower section. Add a clearly visible permanent dark-green 16dp gap beneath the readings, above all scrolling content. Keep a safe gap above the floating navigation bar. Cross-platform premium neutral, forest green #071B14, warm ivory serif headings, antique gold, muted warm sage body text, restrained subtle surface texture. Large readable app-native text, practical phone spacing and touch targets. Use the same Callixtus I painted gold-framed portrait from the screenshot, same saint across all options. Today label is "Saint of the day" and date "14 October"; no fake streaks, completion counts, tasks, badges or added features. Lower section must include Saint of the day, Callixtus I, Morning offering, Pray the Rosary, and Continue reading with Callixtus I / Pope. Concise portrait description may read "Pope and martyr, remembered for mercy and reconciliation." This is illustrative UI copy. Preserve the readings content: "Weekday", "Galatians 5:18–25", "Luke 11:42–46", "VERSE OF THE DAY · Luke 11:42", source "Douay-Rheims American Edition (1899)", and "Read full readings · USCCB". Keep the upper excerpt as in the source image rather than adding new scripture. Keep top system safe area and bottom home indicator clear. Center the entire thin silver phone frame on a plain near-black background with small even margins. Tall portrait composition approximately 1:2.05, content dominates the device frame. No option labels inside the app, no annotations, no watermarks.

options.name: Option 1: Open layout
options.prompt: DESIGN OPTION 1 — OPEN EDITORIAL LAYOUT. Below the fixed gap, use a refined open borderless arrangement, NOT the original saint box. A single ivory serif heading "Saint of the day" with small gold date at right. Beneath it, a generous gold-framed rectangular saint portrait at left; at right name "Callixtus I", two-to-three-line short summary and small gold chevron, all directly on the forest-green page WITHOUT outer card or enclosing rounded border. Thin antique-gold divider below. Heading "A moment of prayer", then two spacious borderless icon/text actions side by side: a gold sunrise with "Morning offering" and a gold rosary with "Pray the Rosary", each with a small chevron. Separate them with a subtle vertical hairline, not cards. Finally "Continue reading" and a low, flat row with a small circular portrait, "Callixtus I", "Pope", and arrow. Elegant controlled spacing, clear horizontal alignment, noticeably less boxed than the screenshot. All three groups clearly visible and readable above the existing dock. The saint portrait should remain visibly larger than the recent-reading thumbnail.

options.name: Option 2: Portrait carousel
options.prompt: DESIGN OPTION 2 — PORTRAIT CAROUSEL. Below the permanent gap, heading "Saint of the day" with "14 October" on the right. The scrolling zone features a horizontal swipeable saint card shelf: one broad landscape card showing Callixtus I's clear gold-framed portrait on the LEFT, a dark-green readable text area on the RIGHT with "Callixtus I", a short two-line description and "Discover their life →"; a narrow edge of a next portrait card at the far right gives a subtle horizontal-swipe affordance. Do not invent another saint name or imply an extra feast date. Three tiny closely spaced gold/sage indicator dots directly beneath the shelf, centered. Then compact gold-icon prayer actions in a SINGLE understated full-width horizontal strip labelled "Morning offering" and "Pray the Rosary" separated by a fine vertical line. Below is a distinct slim "Continue reading" row with a circular Callixtus portrait, "Callixtus I", "Pope", and chevron. Focus on imagery, with card text near its lower edge, a sharply visible face and restrained fades only behind text. The shelf should feel clearly swipeable and be the primary differentiator; avoid repeating original stacked card boxes. Keep sections modest enough to read comfortably above the unchanged floating bar.

options.name: Option 3: Daily journal
options.prompt: DESIGN OPTION 3 — DAILY JOURNAL. Below the permanent gap, show a single cohesive, softly shaded deep-green rounded journal panel with a thin muted antique-gold edge, labelled "Your day in faith" in ivory serif with a small "14 October" at the upper right. Inside this ONE panel use three OPEN sections separated ONLY by thin horizontal hairlines: first a "Saint of the day" gold label and large Callixtus I portrait on the RIGHT beside his ivory name and two lines of summary on the LEFT, with a small arrow; second a "A moment of prayer" subheading followed by two flat touch actions (sunrise icon + "Morning offering", rosary icon + "Pray the Rosary") placed side by side with a fine vertical divider; third "Continue reading" with a compact small circular Callixtus portrait, "Callixtus I", "Pope" and arrow. Absolutely no cards inside the journal panel, no individual prayer boxes, no redundant repeated dates. Airy and calm, visually unified like a devotional journal, clearly different from the borderless option and the carousel. Keep the panel fully readable and separated from the original floating navigation bar.
